paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a preference model over a series of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1200 with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Training Loss," also using a linear scale, with a range from 0 to 14 and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot features a single line, shown in blue, with no markers and a solid line style. The line begins at a value slightly above 13 on the y-axis when the x-axis is at 0, indicating a high initial loss. It then rapidly decreases, reaching a value close to 1 by approximately 100 training steps. After this initial decline, the line shows a steady trend, remaining near zero for the remainder of the plot across the x-axis. A legend with a label is provided on the top right of the line plot.
